headline: Huawei develops innovative packaging technology to circumvent US sanctions on critical 3D NAND chips for high-capacity SSDs.
summary: Huawei's successful development of proprietary chip packaging technology for high-capacity SSDs directly challenges U.S. export controls and demonstrates China's increasing self-reliance in critical semiconductor components. This move significantly impacts global semiconductor supply chains, potentially accelerating tech decoupling and altering the future architecture of AI infrastructure by creating alternative component sources.
